audit_log.value: I run a small landscaping company and need an agreement for recurring work with a homeowner whose requests keep expanding. It started with mowing and trimming, then became mulch installation, sprinkler repairs, fence cleanup, hauling debris, flower bed redesign, and occasional seasonal planting. They often ask for extra tasks while I’m already on site and expect it to be included. I need clear approval rules for added work, pricing for extras, payment due dates, late fees, weather delays, rescheduling, access to the property, responsibility for hidden irrigation lines or underground damage I wasn’t told about, photo permission for completed work, and protection for my trailer, tools, and equipment if damaged on site. They also still owe me for prior visits and say they’ll add it to the next invoice. I want something practical, professional, fair, and easy for both sides to review, collaborate on changes, and sign once finalized.
